name: openbb_equity_fundamental_overview
description:
Meant to give an all-in-one fundamental overview of one company through OpenBB (obb.equity.fundamental.overview).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol; provider (schema default fmp; omitted sends yfinance).
OpenBB 4.x (4.6 checked) has no obb.equity.fundamental.overview, so this tool currently returns an error object; alternatives: openbb_equity_profile, openbb_equity_metrics, yf_stock_info or av_company_overview.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "provider": "fmp"}
